lenses.name: Alpha lifecycle single authority
lenses.guide: Review the alpha compaction lifecycle for one coherence improvement. Preserve current behavior and local fallback. There is no backward-compatibility requirement. Follow one compaction attempt from native summary through authorization, identity, serialization, remote request, persistence, and replay preparation. Look for one environmental fact resolved more than once, ordering knowledge split across helpers, or a failure path whose owner is ambiguous. Prefer one authoritative value and a linear fail-closed flow. Accept a refactor only if it deletes duplicate work or coordination and does not add a class, state machine, generic pipeline, or new public interface. Report one global lifecycle opportunity, not a small error, style issue, or request for more logging.
